$note: FULL Safarilink 2026 route network - expands substantially beyond the two routes already captured in flights-amboseli-mara-nanyuki-2026.json (nanyukiToMasaiMara and amboseliTsavoToMara). Both of those pre-existing figures are CONFIRMED to match this document exactly ($441 published / $374.80 nett + $15 tax for Nanyuki-Mara; $331.50 nett + $15 tax for Amboseli/Tsavo-Mara) - no discrepancy found, just re-verified. Everything else below is newly captured.

source.extractionMethod: Clean embedded text layer via pdftotext -layout.

generalChildRule: Child fare is 75% of the adult fare, EXCEPT Tanzania through-fares (Mara-Migori-Tarime-Serengeti connector) where child (2-11 years) is 80% of the adult fare. Consistent with what's already noted in flights-amboseli-mara-nanyuki-2026.json.

nairobiMasaiMara.note: Operates into multiple strips, timings may vary significantly.

masaiMaraToMigori.note: Vice versa (v.v.). Min 4 pax per service year-round.

masaiMaraToUkundaMombasa.note: Will operate in high season from June 2026, min 6 pax per service, or may re-route via Wilson.

nairobiAmboseli.note: Can be combined with Tsavo West; confirm timings 24hrs prior.

nairobiKimanaAmboseli.note: Combined service with Amboseli; afternoon flights don't operate in low season.

amboseliTsavoToMara.note: CONFIRMED match to the existing flights-amboseli-mara-nanyuki-2026.json figure. Direct routing in high season, min 2 pax/airstrip, 4 pax/service; otherwise reroutes via Wilson.

amboseliToLoisabaSamburuLewa.note: Combined Amboseli/Tsavo to Laikipia service operates direct in high season from Jan 2026, min 2 pax/airstrip, 4 pax/service. Airstrips within Samburu & Nanyuki may be combined. May reroute via Wilson.

nairobiTsavoWest.note: Can be combined with Amboseli; afternoon flights don't operate in low season.

nairobiNanyuki.note: Serves Nanyuki Civil or Kamok strips. Low season: Laikipia-Mara may route via Wilson.

nanyukiToMasaiMara.note: CONFIRMED match to the existing flights-amboseli-mara-nanyuki-2026.json figure.

nairobiLoisabaSamburuLewa.note: Samburu area service uses Kalama and Sasaab strips. Low season: Laikipia-Mara may route via Wilson.

nairobiLamu.note: Other fares/classes available; stricter T&Cs apply to those.

nairobiKilimanjaro.note: Min 4 pax high season, 6 pax low season. NOTE: this is a materially different fare from AirKenya's competing Wilson-Kilimanjaro/Arusha route ($210 rack, same coincidentally, but AirKenya's tax is $70-128 not $65-75) and different minimum-pax rule - don't conflate carriers.

tanzaniaThroughFaresViaMigoriTarime2026.note: Two parallel connecting-carrier options from Mara into the Serengeti, both via a Safarilink Mara-Migori flight + road transfer Migori-Tarime (~1hr incl. immigration, arranged by the connecting carrier) + onward flight on the connecting carrier. Fare INCLUDES the road transfer. Child (2-11) = 80% of fare (differs from the 75% general rule). Requires Kenya visa in advance and valid yellow fever certificate for Tanzania entry. Safarilink serves max 3 Mara strips for this connection: Olkiombo, Keekorok, and either Mara North or Kichwa - other strips considered case-by-case.
tanzaniaThroughFaresViaMigoriTarime2026.minPax: 2 per strip, 4 per service in high season; low season (1 Apr-15 Jun, 1 Nov-15 Dec) requests considered at min 4 per strip AND per service.
tanzaniaThroughFaresViaMigoriTarime2026.bookingRule: Reservations may be made through either airline but must show complete routing on ONE voucher for the through-fare to apply; camps/lodges for both TZ and Mara must be indicated.
tanzaniaThroughFaresViaMigoriTarime2026.cancellationPolicy: Cancellations within 14 days of travel = 100% no-show charge. Amendments within 7 days = $100 penalty ($50 per airline).

multiSectorDiscount2026.note: Book 3+ flights on Safarilink scheduled services only.
rules: Must be booked on ONE voucher/PNR, else individual sector fares apply.
Taxes excluded from discount, applied per sector.
Net fare = applicable seasonal published (not nett) fare x discount%; a return fare can substitute for 2 singles if cheaper. No retrospective credit notes.

groupFares2026.note: Safarilink scheduled services only, off Gross Fare.
groupFares2026.combinabilityNote: Group fares and multi-sector discounts cannot be combined.

termsAndConditions.applicability: Y & M class fares only; other classes have different, more restrictive conditions.

cancellation.festiveEasterException: 14-day window applies over Easter (2-6 Apr 2026) and Festive period (16 Dec 2026-10 Jan 2027) instead of the standard 7-day window.

amendment.above7Days: Nil charge (same class only, else fare difference applies)

termsAndConditions.ticketValidity: 1 year from first date of travel on first ticket issuance.
termsAndConditions.nameChanges: $30 on fully unutilized tickets; not permitted after travel.
termsAndConditions.flightClosure: Safarilink may close flights 7 days in advance; min-pax bookings thereafter considered at discretion with possible revised minimum.

baggage.standardAllowance: 15kg per person, soft bags, inclusive of hand luggage/cameras.

coastalRoutesAllowance.routes: KIS, UKA, MYD, LAU, MBA, ZNZ

excessBaggageRate.unit: per kg, VAT inclusive, subject to payload/space availability, max 10kg at this per-kg rate before the advance-purchase table applies
